summary: The ten-growing-portion chair deferral counter is process-local and resets after every supervisor restart. Persist continuation visits and migrate the current non-deferred run from saved chunk counts, preserving the original deferral and completion policy.
rollback: Scoped source revert and preserved immutable runtime-v6. Before any legacy fallback, preserve the new queue ledger and reconcile its counter with actual saved chunk/defer history; older frozen supervisors do not maintain this new field.
